openimages-v7.notes: Use OriginalURL and OriginalMD5. Never use Thumbnail300KURL as canonical bytes.

smithsonian-open-access.anonymous_access: HTTPS or S3 --no-sign-request; no account or API key required
smithsonian-open-access.notes: Collect explicitly selected unit/shard snapshots with collect-smithsonian; require both metadata_usage.access and selected media usage.access to equal CC0; prefer High-resolution JPEG.

wikimedia-commons.notes: Collect reviewed File titles with collect-commons and verify every resulting file page and revision.
